messages.subject: R873 report complete
messages.body: Produced the bounded 1,655-word knowledge-collection report comparing WS, OS, RS, and flexible mappings with source-backed FC/MLP shape and resource limits. It finds Eyeriss's modeled RS energy advantage at batches 16–256, alongside a batch-1 DRAM floor, an FC output-stationary mismatch, and TPU v1 MLP underutilization, while separating model estimates from device counters. The report is ready for native Codex review and indexing; SHA-256 is 1ae234df104e5260955c71bb25c22ad26c6f51e3e76186ebf0460266119f755e.

messages.subject: R871 source audit complete
messages.body: Completed the 1,486-word source-backed audit at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/research-round871-v1.txt (SHA256 d472b8abba13df53085bf1c1bbf0c1cfc539f0f3e681cccb90c05b2d96e16a32). It finds that the Dm two-byte view alone fits 16,384 routed rows exactly, while the full window lacks current two-chunk route, input, state, and publication ownership; current native16 Dm outputs are BF16, not FP16. No code or tests were changed, and numerical quality, performance, output-format selection, and default adoption remain open gates.
